style_line: A body of work whose signature moves are: A continuous ribbon of tall narrow casements between narrow brick piers set directly under a deeply cantilevered, very low-pitched hipped roof with a thin fascia, running the full length of the main storey (00005, 00006, 00019, 00020, 00021); A long thin living-dining bar with a central brick chimney-and-stair core on its long axis, the rooms flowing past the core on both sides, a continuous glazed-door wall onto a full-length balcony, and pointed glazed prow bays at both ends (00003, 00017, 00005); Brick drawn as horizontal courses only, every wall top, sill, pier and chimney capped by a plain light band, with low stepped garden walls carrying planter urns on piers extending the base outward (00005, 00006, 00019, 00020, 00021).
